  status       Print deterministic bootstrap status as JSON
  init         Register a local repository root
  repo list    List registered repositories as JSON

  callers Direct callers of the anchored identity as JSON
  callees Direct callees of the anchored identity as JSON
  trace Bounded plausible static paths with per-hop evidence
  impact Conservative inbound impact with evidence and UNKNOWN default
